name: Blade Practice
description: +1 SL on melee attack tests per rank, from steady drilling with a blade.

name: Steady Aim
description: +1 SL on ranged attack tests per rank; a calm breath before every shot.

name: Battle Instinct
description: +1 SL on all attack tests; a sixth sense for the flow of a fight.

name: Tough Hide
description: +2 Wounds per rank; weathered skin that shrugs off knocks.

name: Oxen Constitution
description: +3 Wounds per rank; stamina that outlasts the rest of the party.

name: Snap Reaction
description: +5 Initiative per rank; the body moves before the mind finishes the thought.

name: Tavern Brawler
description: +1 SL on melee attack tests; years of scraps in crowded taprooms.

name: Keen Sighting
description: +1 SL on ranged attack tests; a sharp eye for distant targets.

name: Shield Drill
description: +1 SL on melee attack tests and +2 Wounds; formation training with a shield.

name: Watchful
description: +5 Initiative; always half-ready for trouble.

name: Last Stand Grit
description: +3 Wounds; stands firm when others would fall.

name: Ambusher
description: +1 SL on ranged attack tests and +5 Initiative; patient and quick from cover.

name: Fencer's Footwork
description: +1 SL on melee attack tests and +5 Initiative; light, precise steps.

name: Oarsman's Back
description: +2 Wounds; a back built by long hours at the oars.

name: Cudgel Work
description: +1 SL on melee attack tests; knows how to use a stick and a street corner.

name: Knife Thrower
description: +1 SL on ranged attack tests; a knack for throwing blades true.

name: Veteran's Poise
description: +1 SL on all attack tests and +5 Initiative; the calm of someone who has seen it all before.

name: Hearty Eater
description: +2 Wounds per rank; a strong stomach and the strength it brings.

name: Alert Sleeper
description: +5 Initiative per rank; wakes at the faintest rustle.

name: Pack Mule
description: +2 Wounds; used to hauling heavy loads for days.

name: Lettered
description: Can read and write. The GM allows reading documents and notes that others cannot.

name: Tongue for Tongues
description: Picks up languages quickly. Each rank, the GM allows a new language to be learned in a short time.

name: Court Manners
description: Knows etiquette of the high halls. The GM grants an edge when mingling with nobles and officials.

name: Silver Tongue
description: Persuasive speaker. Each rank, the GM grants an edge on Charm-style social tests.

name: Haggler's Instinct
description: Knows what a thing is worth. Each rank, the GM grants an edge when bargaining.

name: Night Owl
description: Stays alert through the dark hours. The GM waives fatigue penalties for a night without sleep.

name: Light Fingers
description: Nimble hands. Each rank, the GM grants an edge on sleight-of-hand and pickpocketing.

name: Lock Whisperer
description: Has a feel for latches and tumblers. Each rank, the GM grants an edge when picking locks.

name: Trail Sense
description: Rarely loses the path. Each rank, the GM grants an edge on navigation in the wild.

name: Way with Beasts
description: Animals trust this character. The GM allows calming or befriending ordinary beasts.

name: Weather Eye
description: Reads sky and wind. The GM reveals approaching weather ahead of time.

name: River Reader
description: Understands currents and shoals. The GM grants an edge when crossing or navigating rivers.

name: Born Swimmer
description: Swims as easily as walking. The GM waives penalties for swimming in calm water.

name: Steady Hands
description: Precise handiwork. Each rank, the GM grants an edge on delicate work such as surgery or repairs.

name: Green Thumb
description: Knows herbs and growing things. The GM allows identifying and gathering useful plants.

name: Iron Stomach
description: Shrugs off bad food and mild poisons. The GM grants an edge on resisting rot and spoilage.

name: Parade-Ground Voice
description: A voice that carries over any din. The GM allows issuing orders to a crowd or a group of allies.

name: Steel Nerves
description: Hard to frighten. The GM grants an edge when resisting fear.

name: Lamp-Lit Studies
description: Learns well by candlelight. Each rank, the GM grants an edge on research and study.

name: Crowd Reader
description: Senses the mood of a crowd. The GM reveals when a crowd is turning hostile or friendly.

name: Fast Talker
description: Talks fast and confusingly. The GM grants an edge when talking one's way out of trouble.

name: Road-Worn
description: Seasoned traveller. Each rank, the GM grants an edge when enduring long journeys.

name: Keen Ears
description: Hears what others miss. The GM grants an edge on listening tests.

name: Quick Study
description: Lowlander. Picks up a new trade quickly. The GM shortens the time needed to learn a craft.

name: Stone Sense
description: Delver. Notices unsound masonry and hollow walls. The GM reveals structural flaws.

name: Deep Sight
description: Delver. Sees well in dim light. The GM waives penalties for dim light.

name: Light Step
description: Hearthkin. Moves almost silently. The GM grants an edge on sneaking.

name: Underfoot
description: Hearthkin. Small enough to go unnoticed. The GM grants an edge when slipping through a crowd.

name: Twilight Eyes
description: Veyl. Sees clearly at dusk and under starlight. The GM waives penalties for low light.

name: Long Memory
description: Veyl. Carries the memory of generations. The GM may share a relevant piece of old lore.
